dataTable.purpose: The user's Discord ID is used to create and store their turnipRPG profile with things such as their currency balance, xp, inventory, and other things. This data is permanently attached to the user's Discord profile, ensuring continuity and progress tracking in the game.
The Bot keeps track of the mutual servers the user is in with it. This data is used to notify the user what servers have a visiting Merchant, as well as other server specific events.
Additionally, anonymous data on command usage and other interactions may be collected to improve turnipRPG's features and user experience.

title: Cookies
policies: The turnipRPG website uses minimal cookies to enhance user experience and functionality. These cookies do not collect personal information and are used for technical purposes only.

title: Data Retention
policies: turnipRPG profiles associated with Discord IDs are retained indefinitely, unless a user goes through the data deletion process. This allows users to maintain their progress and achievements in the game over time.

Anonymous interaction data may be retained for an indefinite period to improve the game's features and user experience. This data does not contain any personal information and is used for analytical purposes only.

title: Personal Information
policies: turnipRPG does not collect or store any personal information such as usernames, email addresses, or other identifiable data.

title: Data Sharing
policies: User data collected by turnipRPG is strictly confidential and only accessible to the turnipRPG developers. We do not share, sell, or transfer this data to any third parties or services.

title: Data Protection
policies: All user data is stored in an encrypted and secure database, safeguarding it from unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Deletion
policies: Users have the right to request the deletion of their turnipRPG profile and associated data. To initiate a data deletion request, users can contact BradyDaLlama in the support server. Please note that data deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

title: Changes to Privacy policies
policies: The developers of turnipRPG may update this Privacy policies from time to time to reflect changes in data handling practices or legal requirements. It is the user's responsibility to review the privacy policies from time to time to understand the most up to date version.

title: Consent
policies: By using turnipRPG, you consent to the collection and use of your Discord ID and anonymous interaction data as described in this Privacy policies.

title: Contact Information
policies: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding your privacy or the data collected by turnipRPG, please contact a staff member in the support server.
